summary: Alibaba Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its March quarter and fiscal year 2026 annual results. The filing covers unaudited consolidated financials prepared under U.S. GAAP and reviewed by the audit committee. It includes commentary from the CEO and CFO on AI investments, cloud revenue acceleration, and e-commerce performance. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign—is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. earnings press release, and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
